newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF says intends to take strict measures on Nomura.
newsitem.headline: MOF says intends to take strict measures on Nomura.

text.p: Japan's Ministry of Finance (MOF) intends to take severe punitive measures against Nomura Securities Co Ltd, taking into account the results of this morning's hearing with Nomura officials, Vice Finance Minister Takeshi Komura told a news conference on Thursday.
He added that the ministry has yet to decide on a schedule for implementing penalties against Nomura.
Komura also said that the ministry and Nomura were in agreement on the fact Nomura had committed illegal acts.

At a MOF hearing on Thursday morning, Nomura President Junichi Ujiie admitted to allegations made last week by Japan's securities watchdog that the brokerage engaged in illegal stock transactions for a "sokaiya" corporate racketeer.
